# Grimoire

> Web-based D&D 5e campaign management tool for Dungeon Masters.

## What it does

- Campaign, NPC, monster, encounter, and note management
- Faerûn Calendar (Calendar of Harptos) with custom calendar adapter support
- Scriptorium: homebrew document editor styled like the 2024 PHB
- Card Forge: printable MTG-style and Tarot-style stat cards for NPCs, monsters, items, and spells
- Encounter runner with initiative, HP, conditions, factions, and mid-combat spawning
- Player portal — free for all players in a campaign
- Character Codex: species, backgrounds, classes, archetypes, and abilities
- Workshop: crafting recipes and cooking
- Atlas: location management with hierarchy
- Quest log, faction tracker, Hall of Heroes, soundboard integration (Spotify)
- Illuminator: battlegrid map preparation tool

## Pricing

- Free DM: 1 campaign, 10 NPCs, 3 custom monsters, 5 encounters, 3 Scriptorium documents, 10 notes
- Pro DM: unlimited content, 5 AI generation credits/month — see dungeongrimoire.com/pricing for current pricing
- Players always join and play for free, regardless of the DM's plan

## Stack

Vue 3, Supabase (PostgreSQL + Auth), TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS v4
